nodes.label: Rues-Cooking-Hub (reference repo)
nodes.rationale: Shape (Kit 3, #lib imports, node:sqlite migrations, sharp WebP BLOBs, tokens.css, harness, CI) copied from it; read, never modified.

nodes.label: One generic entries table for 11 types
nodes.rationale: Queried/filtered/sorted/linked fields are columns, display-only per-type fields live in a details JSON column so CRUD/list/detail code is written once.

nodes.label: Per-type config TYPES (src/lib/entries/config.ts)
nodes.rationale: Drives form, detail panel, list filters, status labels and which controls appear.

nodes.label: Brand vs Shop/Site kind rule
nodes.rationale: Type follows kind: kind=brand -> brand, shop|site -> site; editing kind moves the entry between tabs.

nodes.label: Status events table
nodes.rationale: Written only when status changes; cheap now and lets the split-off rediscovery change read history without a migration.

nodes.label: Half-star rating storage (rating_x2 1..10)
nodes.rationale: Integers instead of floats; read model exposes rating_x2/2.

nodes.label: Artist link (artist_id ON DELETE SET NULL + artist_name)
nodes.rationale: Deleting an artist clears the link but keeps name text; autofill matches by (artist, deezer, external_id).

nodes.label: Tag dedupe via fold() name_key
nodes.rationale: SQLite NOCASE folds ASCII only, so a JS fold (NFC, trim, collapse whitespace, toLowerCase) is used; unused tags deleted in the same transaction.

nodes.label: Title sort with Intl.Collator
nodes.rationale: So 'Ästhetik' sorts with A; title_key stored only for equality.

nodes.label: Provider interface (Deezer, AniList, Open Library)
nodes.rationale: One interface over injected FetchJson; fake provider in test mode; 5 s budget, safeFetch, descriptive User-Agent.

nodes.label: Deezer API
nodes.rationale: Single music provider: keyless, has artist images; MusicBrainz has none and needs 1 req/s.

nodes.label: Search UI (300 ms debounce, abort on change)
nodes.rationale: Thumbnails load transiently from provider CDN; cover is downloaded server-side only on Save.

nodes.label: URL preview (readPreview, Open Graph)
nodes.rationale: Preview image converted to a WebP data URL and posted back on Save: no orphan image rows, no hotlinking.

nodes.label: SSRF guard safeFetch (src/lib/server/net.ts)
nodes.rationale: Resolves host itself and connects with a lookup returning only the checked address so DNS rebinding is impossible; Cooking-Hub's fetch lacked private-address refusal, hence e2e uses a fake remote.

nodes.label: Test-mode seams (CREATIVE_ARCHIVE_TEST, testFlag)
nodes.rationale: Switches on /__test, /__mockups, fake provider and fake remote in one place each; production never imports a fake.

nodes.label: Image pipeline (sharp -> WebP BLOB, 16 MiB)
nodes.rationale: Copied downscale loop; HEIC (HEVC) is a non-goal since prebuilt sharp can't decode it.

nodes.label: BODY_SIZE_LIMIT=17M
nodes.rationale: Must exceed the 16 MiB image limit plus other form fields; deploy and nginx must match.

nodes.label: Worlds (data-scheme / data-accent / data-font)
nodes.rationale: Picking a world changes only the WORLDS object (data), never CSS or components.

nodes.label: Server API style: load + form actions, JSON only for search/preview
Duplicate-submit guard on forms
nodes.rationale: A duplicate Save during a 160 ms outro made a Cooking-Hub test flaky.

nodes.label: Mockup photos (CC0 via Openverse, CREDITS.txt)
nodes.rationale: Unsplash license isn't CC0; missing shapes generated by scripts/synthetic-photo.mjs; photos never ship in static/ or the tarball.

nodes.label: E2E isolation (one server/db per port, workers 1, reset, calm)
nodes.rationale: Bigger alternative (server+db per project) would halve suite time but need a second port per unit.

nodes.label: Page transitions / cover morph (pageTransition)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic cover-<id> naming so a page never holds duplicate view-transition-names, which abort the transition.

nodes.label: Mouse drag-scroll inertia
nodes.rationale: Touch keeps native momentum; hover tilt only for fine pointers.

nodes.label: Reference files to copy from Cooking-Hub
release.yml bump-pin into Homelab-Managment
nodes.rationale: Target host_vars don't exist until creative-archive-deploy lands, so bump fails on v0.1.0 while publish succeeds (accepted).

nodes.label: Liquid glass material (.liquid)
nodes.rationale: Round 1 feedback: light looked off, wanted iOS liquid glass, no pink.

nodes.label: Type pairings (a Bricolage+Figtree, b Syne+Manrope, c Bodoni Moda+Hanken)
nodes.rationale: Avoids the 'default AI serif' family (Fraunces, Instrument Serif); Cormorant dropped.

nodes.label: UI components (GlassPanel, PillNav, Card, StatusPill, StarRating, ...)
Motion set with test-visible proxies
nodes.rationale: Transform/opacity only, every item has a reduced-motion path.

nodes.label: World pick (all dark; pairing a)
nodes.rationale: Rue approved round-2 mockups 2026-10-31: home stone, music ember, animanga electric, books moss, fashion noir.

nodes.label: Stored vs derived values (derive.ts)
nodes.rationale: Forms post only stored fields; server recomputes derived ones.

nodes.label: Error classes (ValidationError, ImageError, FetchError, ProviderError, DuplicateError)
Recorded provider fixture shapes
nodes.rationale: Hand-written from the 2026-10-31 probe; can drift from live APIs, covered by manual Gate 2 check.

nodes.label: E2E helpers (reset, seed, counts, open, calm, photo)
Missing error colour token
nodes.rationale: motion.test.ts bans raw colours; U11 and U13 used inconsistent fallbacks.

hyperedges.label: Safe remote fetch flow (SSRF guard, preview, providers, fake remote)
World theming: S5 checkpoint, mockups, world pick, tokens
